text:
Aisha: Heads-up — the new small-batch roaster delivery arrives tomorrow at 10am. Whoever's on coffee rota please meet in kitchen to unload. :coffee:
Ben: Oooh which roast? light/medium? :raised_hands:
Aisha: It's a medium-sweet from RedBranch roasters. Tasting notes: caramel, plum. :drooling_face:
Carlos: I volunteer for rota but FYI the grinder is acting up again.
Dana: Noted. I fixed it last month but will take a look before 10.
Ben: Can we do a snack policy quick poll? Some ppl left weird stuff in the freezer again.
Aisha: Yes. Proposal: communal snacks OK but label + date. No mystery tupperware older than 7 days.
Ellen: +1 to label & date. Also suggest 'vegan' tag for dietary needs.
Carlos: Also, can we put a sticker system for 'donated' vs 'personal'?
Dana: Quick troubleshooting note: try gently cleaning the burrs, then run `pulse` cycle. If still noisy, we'll swap in the spare grinder cartridge.
kitchenbot: REMINDER: Kitchen shelf audit scheduled Friday at 4pm. Items older than 30 days flagged. :robot_face:
Ben: For the toaster — it's making a weird smell. Is it safe to use?
Dana: Don't use it. I've put a Post-It on it and unplugged. Facilities ticket submitted: #F-4217
Aisha: Coffee rota sign-up sheet on the fridge. If anyone wants to swap weeks, add a note.
Ellen: Can someone bring biscotti on Thursday? small celebration for onboarding new hires.
Carlos: I can pick up a box from the bakery across the street — gluten free option included.
Ben: Breadknife etiquette reminder: wipe crumbs off and return to drawer. Also please don't jam the lid back on the sugar container.
Aisha: Also printing: new 'Snack Diplomacy' bulletin — I'll pin it to the board with the rota.
Ellen: Love the name. :laughing:
kitchenbot: VOTE: Preferred frequency for restock runs?
Ben: weekly
Carlos: every 2 weeks
Aisha: weekly for coffee, every 2 weeks for snacks
Dana: weekly sounds right
Ellen: biweekly fine
kitchenbot: TALLY: weekly(3) biweekly(2) — weekly wins.
Aisha: Cool. I'll put budget note to Finance for recurring coffee order.
Ben: Thank you! Will bring my enamel mugs back from home tomorrow so we have more.
Carlos: Also leaving one jar of instant for emergencies, label 'EMERGENCY — 1 cup'.
Ellen: Thanks all. Quick note: if you take something from the fridge for lunch please write name & date. We've been clearing unlabelled items Friday.
Aisha: Appreciate it. See you all at 10 for the roaster unload. :truck:
Dana: On it. Coffee hero cape will be worn. :superhero:
Ben: :coffee::heart:
kitchenbot: THREAD CLOSED (automatic) — fridge audit scheduled Fri 4pm.
